controls.name: Typography
controls.purpose: Text helpers: lead, small, display sizes, eyebrow, long-form prose rhythm, pull quote, inline code and truncation. Global classes because prose styles arbitrary content that a shadow root cannot reach.
controls.mobile: Display sizes are fluid (clamp); prose measure caps at 70ch and reflows.
controls.accessibility: Reading text stays at or above the reading size; the measure keeps lines under 70 characters.
